scoring_justification: The paper's optimized ellipse axes are reported values; recomputing from raw FEM outputs is not feasible in the verifier. So we compare s1,s2 to paper gold with tolerance and verify area constraint.

outputs.description: Optimised ellipse semi-axes and solid area from shape optimisation under diffusion-driven degradation.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares s1 and s2 to the paper-reported optimum with an absolute tolerance of 0.1 cm. It also recomputes the solid area from s1 and s2 (A = 2500 − π·s1·s2 cm²) and verifies that the area constraint |(A_ini − A)/A_ini| − 0.03 ≤ 0 holds (A_ini = 2500 − π·10·5 cm²).

steps.description: Compare s1, s2 to paper gold and check area constraint

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference optimum axes from paper (Section 6.1, equation (49)): s1=5 cm, s2=5.525 cm. These are the paper-reported values for the optimised design of the 50x50 cm plate with hole.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper text: the result after 9 iterations is s=[5; 5.525].
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Taken directly from the paper's reported optimum.
